content.intro: Delegates is lesson 101 in Delegates, Lambdas, Events, and Functional Features. Delegates represent callable behavior. Lambdas make small functions easy to express, while events provide a publisher/subscriber pattern with explicit subscription behavior.
content.why_it_matters: Separating a behavior from the code that invokes it supports callbacks, event-driven systems, and composition. This lesson focuses on delegates and shows how to verify the behavior instead of relying on assumptions.

items.title: What delegates are
items.text: A delegate is a type-safe reference to a callable method or function. Func, Action, and Predicate cover common callback shapes; keep callbacks readable and be explicit about captured state.

items.title: Declaring delegate types
items.text: Keep callbacks short and manage event subscriptions so object lifetimes do not create accidental retention or duplicate notifications.
